title: Crop Input Purchasing Accounts: Counter Authority, Carrying Charge and Patronage Standing by Programme
content:
Each programme of Crop Input Purchasing Accounts fixes how far a limit may be raised at the desk in one step, whether such an increase calls for a fresh credit review, whether a current soil test is required before prescription products are sold, the annual charge for carrying the account, and whether spend on the programme earns patronage and under which stream it is allocated.

| Programme | One-step increase at the desk (percent of the existing limit) | Increase needs a fresh review | Soil test required for prescription products | Annual carrying charge (USD) | Earns patronage | Allocated under |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Cash Purchase Account | 0 | yes | no | 0 | no | not allocated |
| Standard 30-Day Charge Account | 20 | no | no | 0 | yes | input dollars |
| Seasonal Terms Crop Input Account | 20 | no | no | 0 | yes | input dollars |
| Early Pay Prepay Program Account | 0 | yes | no | 0 | yes | input dollars |
| Full Acre Input Financing Account | 15 | yes | yes | 250 | yes | input dollars |
| Precision Partner Input Program Account | 15 | yes | yes | 500 | yes | input dollars |

### Reading the columns

The one-step figure is how far a limit may be raised at the desk in a single step, stated as a percentage of the limit already carried: 20 percent on the Standard 30-Day Charge Account and the Seasonal Terms Crop Input Account, 15 percent on the Full Acre Input Financing Account and the Precision Partner Input Program Account, and nothing on the two programmes that carry no limit.

A programme marked as needing a fresh review is one on which an increase is not made without a review recorded afresh by the credit department.

A current soil test is required before prescription products are sold on the Full Acre Input Financing Account and the Precision Partner Input Program Account only.

The annual carrying charge is 250 USD on the Full Acre Input Financing Account and 500 USD on the Precision Partner Input Program Account; no other programme of Crop Input Purchasing Accounts carries one.

Input spend earns patronage allocation on every programme except the Cash Purchase Account, and where it is earned it is allocated under the input dollars stream.
